missing_from_list_summary: The list has substantial omissions, but this bounded audit does not certify exhaustive completeness or all admission metadata. Add_primary: SimpleMem, ReMe, MemMachine, Mem0 OSS core, claude-mem, mcp-memory-service, and HippoRAG. Add_reserve: MemOS, EverOS/EverMemOS lineage, SuperLocalMemory, memU, MemoryOS, AgentMem, RAGFlow, Serena, and the unqualified GitNexus lead. Memobase definitively fails the 90-day rule; Memori's verified current integration fails the no-mandatory-cloud requirement. Reconsidering Mem0 corrects the cloud-plugin/core conflation. Letta remains excluded by comparison scope, while its current local runtime is active. in_current_list includes names explicitly listed as excluded. Forty distinct URLs were attempted; no load exceeded one minute. The GitHub API endpoint and incorrectly guessed LadybugDB/GitNexus URL failed. GitHub CLI authentication and shell networking were unavailable. Many repository root pages omitted dynamic commit metadata, so their keep recommendations are provisional, not verified maintenance admissions. Commit dates have day precision, without verified UTC timestamps; tags are latest observed primary-source/indexed releases, not a guarantee against indexing lag. archived=false reflects inspected repository presentation, not authenticated API verification. Local capability is documentation/source-based and was not installation-tested; false for harnesses means a fully local reader/judge path was not verified. Search-only GitNexus and beads have empty sources rather than unopened URLs. Remaining unqualified discovery frontier includes LangMem, LightMem, MIRIX, A-MEM, Haystack, RAG-Anything, PageIndex, Code-RAG, and broader RAG applications. Additional harness leads include mem0ai/memory-benchmarks, supermemoryai/memorybench, MemTensor/OmniMemEval, MemoryArena, and EverMemBench; their release/activity metadata was not qualified within the page budget. Before freezing the preregistration, resolve unknown activity against the 2026-07-02 cutoff, pin exact implementations/adapters, separate retrieval recall from answer accuracy, and normalize reader/judge models, ingestion and retrieval token budgets. Current local implementations must be rerun rather than inheriting scores from cloud products, predecessors or different benchmark subsets.
